node.title: LGBTQIA+ Skip the Small Talk Night at Threes Brewing Gowanus
node.description:
**###PLEASE NOTE: Even if you RSVP on Meetup, you will need to grab a ticket here https://www.skipthesmalltalk.com/store/lgbtqia-skip-the-small-talk-night-at-threes-brewing-gowanus-tuesday-december-1-2026 in order to attend###** This event is cross-posted so Meetup RSVPs won't accurately reflect the actual number of attendees; typically there are around 30-40 people in attendance.

Folks in this Meetup group get **10% off**! Use code: **MEETUP** at checkout.

**What's It Like?**

Do you wish you could have more of the kinds of conversations you have late at night where for some reason, you feel safe talking about the things you actually care about?

Bring your friends (or come by yourself- most people do!) and spend your Tuesday night at an event where you know everyone else is there for the same reason.

We'll be offering 'big talk' conversational prompts on them to get you started, and we'll have lots of structure to make sure that you actually talk to people and that it's not awkward.

There will be food and drinks available for sale!

**Check-in** for this event will begin around **6:45 pm**. Please do your best to arrive before 7:00 pm so we can begin as close to on time as possible.

Skip the Small Talk is dedicated to providing an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone. Check out our safety policy here: tinyurl.com/ststSafety

Please see our event [page](https://www.skipthesmalltalk.com/store/lgbtqia-skip-the-small-talk-night-at-threes-brewing-gowanus-tuesday-december-1-2026) for more accessibility info.

**Ready to Skip the Small Talk With Us?**

**[Grab a ticket](https://www.skipthesmalltalk.com/store/lgbtqia-skip-the-small-talk-night-at-threes-brewing-gowanus-tuesday-december-1-2026)** since entry is on a first come first serve basis and we tend to sell out in advance for these-- once we are out of tickets, we will NOT be able to accommodate folks at the door.

If you want to be the first to hear about our events before we sell out, feel free to join our mailing list at [Skip the Small Talk Mailing List Sign-Up](https://sendfox.com/skipthesmalltalk)

For refunds or transfers, please contact use at info@skipthesmalltalk.com

node.title: Online Tristate Speed Dating - Men & Women ages 30s and 40s
node.description:
**RESERVATIONS REQUIRED**
This is a prepay only event at [https://www.weekenddating.com/event-details.aspx?id=13870](https://www.weekenddating.com/event-details.aspx?id=13870) (This is NOT a pay at the door event. Ignore any references that say to RSVP and pay the organizer directly.)

Online Tristate Speed Dating - Men and Women ages 30s and 40s
Tuesday, December 1, 2026, 7:00–8:00 PM Eastern
Online via Zoom. Register at the website above to receive the Zoom link. A Meetup RSVP is not a ticket.

**MEET LOCAL SINGLES ONLINE**
Hey singles from NYC and the surrounding areas! Ready to rev up your dating game with a fun, fast-paced Virtual Speed Dating event? Picture yourself hopping onto a Zoom Speed Dating session where you can meet up to 10 potential matches in just one evening.

Since 2003, we’ve been hosting these lively events and have witnessed over 85 couples find their perfect connection.

**BEFORE THE EVENT**
Join us for one of our exciting NYC Virtual Speed Dating events and sign on a few minutes early to settle in and relax. Arriving a little ahead of time helps you ease into the experience, so you can fully enjoy a night of fun and meeting new people.

**HOW IT WORKS**
Worried about things getting awkward? No need! Our events are designed to help everyone feel at ease. After a couple of rounds, you’ll be laughing, chatting, and getting to know some awesome singles.

After each round, jot down your favorite matches and any notes you want to remember. The ladies stay in place while the gentlemen rotate to meet someone new, keeping the conversations fresh and exciting.

**YOUR MATCHES**
As the night comes to an end, send your top choices to the host, and within about an hour, you’ll receive your matches! Both mutual matches and one-sided interest are provided.

**PRICE & REGISTRATION**
Price: $27.24 including the $3.25 ticket fee through November 30; $29.24 on December 1.

This is a prepay only event at [https://www.weekenddating.com/event-details.aspx?id=13870](https://www.weekenddating.com/event-details.aspx?id=13870) (This is NOT a pay at the door event. Ignore anything that says otherwise.) RSVPs on here do not reflect actual attendance as this is a multi-group event.

node.title: 40s & 50s Speed Dating (Comp Drink for Ladies)
node.description:
**\*TO ATTEND GET TICKETS AT:** [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/upscale-speed-dating-40s-50s-after-party-tickets-2004932375707?aff=oddtdtcreator&keep_tld=true](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/upscale-speed-dating-40s-50s-after-party-tickets-2004932375707?aff=oddtdtcreator&keep_tld=true)
(Must purchase a ticket in advance to attend.)
Ladies will receive a complimentary cocktail of choice (alcoholic/non) before 7 pm. Here is how it will work: in our own private VIP room/section, ladies will sit and men will rotate. Everyone will have personalized 1 on 1 5-minute conversation in order to determine if this person is aligned as a match!
Your matches will be delivered the next day guaranteed via by email, phone number or both! The amount of early bird priced tickets in not indicative of the event capacity and prices can change at any time without notice as will be a sellout.
WHAT TO EXPECT:

* Great speed dating event in one of NYC's best venues
* Ladies will receive a complimentary cocktail (alcoholic/non) before 7 pm
* Unbeatable price point for speed dating

As the venue is waiving their large rental fee and providing comp drinks for ladies, a 1 item minimum spend is required for ladies, and a 2 item spend for men is required for men at the venue.
Dress code: Dress to impress/business casual. No t-shirts, sneakers, hats
For more fun events follow: [https://www.eventbrite.com/o/new-york-city-social-events-10797526283](https://www.eventbrite.com/o/new-york-city-social-events-10797526283)

node.title: 40s & Over Singles Jingle Mingle (Free Drink for Ladies)
node.description:
**\*TO ATTEND GET TICKETS AT:** [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/40s-over-singles-jingle-mingle-free-drink-for-ladies-tickets-2004985979036?aff=oddtdtcreator&keep_tld=true](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/40s-over-singles-jingle-mingle-free-drink-for-ladies-tickets-2004985979036?aff=oddtdtcreator&keep_tld=true)
(\*This is co-organized by 30+ groups so don't go by RSVPs you see here. We'll have a good # attending.)
The holiday season is always great time to meet new people! Join in and mingle with fun, mature NYC singles & socialites ages 40s & over while sipping cocktails at one of NYC’S most chic and sophisticated venues “**FLAIRMAISON LOUNGE”** located inside the Hilton.
We understand… You’re tired of the NYC bars packed with 20 somethings and want to mingle with a more mature crowd.
That’s why we throw our 40s & Over Singles & Social Mixer. Whether you’re looking to make new friends or want to meet that special someone… you’ll have a great time at this event. **Ladies will receive a complimentary beverage of choice from the whole bar before a 7:30 pm arrival time**
What to expect:
• Suggested Age Range: 40s, 50s, and 60s
• Ladies will receive a complimentary beverage (alcoholic, non), cocktail, beer, wine, prosecco, champagne before a 7:30 pm
• Great Music Played at Conversational Level (Just Right for Mingling)
• Typically, 75% of Attendees Come Alone, 25% bring friends
• Expect up to 50 people to attend
• Great drinks and food available at the Bar! As Flairmaison Lounge is waiving their large group reservation rental fee across 2 rooms, providing comp cocktails for ladies, please note there’s a 1 item minimum spend for ladies and a 2-item minimum spend in food/drink for men required at the venue.
• Dress Code: Neat, Professional and/or Stylish.
For more fun events follow: **[https://www.eventbrite.com/o/new-york-city-social-events-10797526283](https://www.eventbrite.com/o/new-york-city-social-events-10797526283)**

node.title: NYC Holiday Lights Social Walk
node.description:
**\*TO ATTEND GET TICKETS AT:** [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/nyc-holiday-lights-social-walk-tickets-2004720850028?aff=oddtdtcreator&keep_tld=true](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/nyc-holiday-lights-social-walk-tickets-2004720850028?aff=oddtdtcreator&keep_tld=true)
'Tis the season… to meet merry & bright people, make new holly jolly friends, and enjoy the iconic holiday decorations in NYC! Join us for a social stroll through midtown as your host leads you from 34th Street to Rockefeller Center. While getting to know all the others along the walk, you will see The Macy’s Windows, Bryant Park Christmas Tree, 6th Avenue Lights, Radio City and the Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree! And at the end of the tour we can find some outdoor space to socialize
What we will cover:
\*Macy’s, Herald Square and surrounding area
\*Bryant Park Tree and holiday shops
\*Avenue of the Americas
\*Radio City, Rock Center Christmas Tree
\*St. Pats Saks 5th Ave Windows
FAQs:
Cost? $20-$25 depending when ticket is purchased and # of spots available
Can I come alone? Yes, 90% of those attending this event normally register on their own. You're welcome to bring as many non member guests, friends & co workers as you’d like, just make sure to register for the total number of tickets. Our staff will be ready to greet you and introduce you to others whether you are on your own or with guests.
Dress Code? Dress for the weather
Ages? 21+
How will I find the group? DAY OF THE EVENT (if you use Gmail, check your social folder), we will send you a confirmation email with exact locations, contact info and names of those who are hosting the event.
